# Canonical names

This canonical revision updates the framework-owned introduction while keeping
three independently named adopter tags in their original positions.

<!-- cumaru:hyphen-tag -->
Canonical placeholder for a hyphenated tag.
<!-- /cumaru:hyphen-tag -->

Framework guidance between the first and second tags belongs to the source.

<!-- cumaru:plans:plan:task -->
Canonical placeholder for a qualified tag.
<!-- /cumaru:plans:plan:task -->

<!-- cumaru:under_score -->
Canonical placeholder for an underscored tag.
<!-- /cumaru:under_score -->

<!-- cumaru:plans:item-* -->
Canonical placeholder for a wildcard-qualified tag.
<!-- /cumaru:plans:item-* -->

The canonical closing note should appear in the merged result.
